images.caption:
Albany, Ga., — Georgia Army National Guardsman, Spc. Shaquiel Smith, a horizontal construction engineer with the 177th Engineering Company of Atlanta, prepares to load tarps and M.R.E’s for local residents effected by the hurricane in Albany, Ga. The Georgia Army National Guard and the State Defense Force established points of distribution to give the local residents food, water and tarps.

(U.S. Army National Guard photo by Pfc. Isaiah Matthews/Released)
